tagline.en: Long-running global eSIM brand with subscription unlimited plans
tagline.zh: 老牌全球 eSIM 品牌，带订阅制不限量

description.en: BNESIM is a long-running global eSIM brand marketing "Zero Roaming" in 200+ countries, with pay-as-you-go packs, subscription-based unlimited tiers and lifetime-validity options. The site shows 4.x ratings and frequent double-data promotions.
description.zh: BNESIM 是运营多年的老牌全球 eSIM 品牌，主打"Zero Roaming"，覆盖 200+ 国家，有按量包、订阅制不限量档与终身有效选项，站点常驻翻倍流量促销。

dataFrom.zh: 按量、订阅制或终身有效

validity.zh: 按量按期；订阅/终身选项不过期

details.en:
BNESIM is a long-running global eSIM brand ("Zero Roaming" positioning) covering 200+ countries, with a product line more complex than typical travel brands: pay-as-you-go packs, subscription-based unlimited tiers and lifetime-validity options coexist - suited to heavy and long-horizon users.

Store rendering note: destination pages render client-side, and a first-party price table could not be captured on 2026-11-10; only a DOUBLE11 double-data promo (valid to Nov 22, 2026) was visible. Third-party directories list entry pricing around $0.62 - recorded here as unverified third-party pricing; trust the app/checkout for actual figures.

Who it fits: heavy long-term data needs (subscription unlimited) and buyers who want a lifetime pack with no expiry worry. Caveats: the three-layer pricing structure (PAYG/subscription/lifetime) is hard to compare; promo-driven pricing moves often; per-destination networks are not disclosed.
details.zh:
BNESIM 是运营多年的老牌全球 eSIM 品牌（"Zero Roaming" 口径），覆盖 200+ 国家和地区，产品线比一般旅行品牌复杂：按量付费包、订阅制不限量档与终身有效包并存，适合重度用户长期持有。

官网渲染说明：商店按目的地页为客户端渲染，2026-11-10 未能直抓第一方价目，仅见 2026-11-22 前有效的 DOUBLE11 翻倍流量促销码；第三方目录列其入门价约 $0.62——本条按「未核实的第三方口径」记录，实际以 App/结算页为准。

适合人群：大流量长期需求（订阅不限量）、想要终身包不担心过期的用户。坑点：定价体系三层（按量/订阅/终身）较难比价；促销驱动定价变动频繁；未按目的地披露落地网络。

bestFor.en: Heavy data users who want subscription unlimited or lifetime validity
bestFor.zh: 大流量用户、想要订阅制不限量或终身有效包

zh: 第三方口径入门价很低

plansNote.en: 2026-11-11: the BNESIM web catalog does not expose plan/price pages (store is in-app); entry pricing remains the third-party ~$0.62 figure, unverified.
plansNote.zh: 2026-11-11 复核：BNESIM 网页端不公开套餐/价格页（商店在 App 内）；入门价维持第三方口径约 $0.62，未核实。

note.en: Multi-network wholesale access; per-destination details not disclosed (2026-11-10).
